# Conventional Commits

This project follows the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) specification for commit messages.

All commits in this PR have been rewritten to follow this format.

## Format

```
<type>: <description>

[optional body]

[optional footer]
```

## Types Used

- **feat**: A new feature
- **fix**: A bug fix
- **docs**: Documentation changes
- **ci**: CI/CD changes
- **chore**: Maintenance tasks
- **refactor**: Code refactoring
- **test**: Adding or updating tests
- **style**: Code style changes (formatting, etc.)

## Examples from This Project

- `ci: add GitHub Actions workflow for demo deployment to Pages`
- `fix: add missing browser shims for demo build`
- `docs: add GitHub Pages setup guide and update README`
- `refactor: remove duplicate isIP functions from empty.js shim`
